rides.title: DIRTY TUESDAY | AMAGER SOCIAL | GRAVEL BEERS N BURGERS 🍔
rides.description:
Hey all,

Join our Dirty Tuesday gravel training in and around Amager with a new weekly route.

What to expect:
Hill sprint at km 3
Vo2 sprints at km 15, 28 and 41

Details:
Meet up 17:20 - Roll out 17:30
Tempo 24-25 - Distance 50km +/-
2 flats on the house (find your own way)
Bring plugs, co2 & energy.
You must be able to ride 50k at 24k avg. 
We ride in 10-12 pax groups in same tempo.
Cancellation protocol: < 5 riders & heavy rain 

We look forward to riding dirt with you and wrap it up with beer & burgers at our favourite hangout spot - Bootleggers.

Team Dirty Tuesday

rides.title: Women’s weekly gravel training X OTTO 🍕
rides.description:
Join us for our weekly women’s gravel. This week we will finish at the shop, where there will be Otto pizza and soft drinks 🍕
Before we head out, you need to order and pay for a pizza and a soft drink. Price: 80 DKK.

The ride will be a training ride with a steady pace. We will do intervals on Manglebjerg (2 loops) and a “mini race” at Chaussen at Dyrehaven (everything is optional) 

Remember to bring snacks, spare parts and good vibes🫶🏻

*****************************************
Meeting point: Klubben aka Copenhagen Cycling Club
Meet up: 17:20
Roll-out: 17:30
Distance: aprox. 60km
Pace: +/- 25-26 km/h
Surface: gravel 

See you for a fun training 
// Caroline & Julie

rides.title: Training Ride
rides.description:
Join us for our Training Ride — a challenging group session designed to push your limits alongside dedicated cyclists. We'll ride intervals on different loops, and always regrouping afterwards to return to the city together. During transport we’ll ride as a one group, rotating turns at the front. Riders should be comfortable with group riding and familiar with standard hand and vocal signals. If you have a puncture or mechanical issue, we expect you have the route downloaded and will to rejoin the group on your own. We run a monthly rotation of efforts to vary the training. We encourage doing intervals in smaller groups when appropriate.

Week 1: 2 x 12 min at Uvelse **
Week 2: 3 x 8 min at Kettinge   
Week 3: 4 x 4 min at Bregnerød 
Week 4: Small race at Flyveren 2 laps in total 

If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!
Meeting Point: Århusgade 126, 2150 Nordhavn
Meeting time: 17.00
Start time: 17.15
Distance: 75-80 +/-
Pace: 32-34 km/h
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event.
#TrainingRide

rides.title: Shake-out ride | Day before BERLIN to COPENHAGEN | Nordic Chase 2026
rides.description:
The Pre-Chase Shake Out 🇩🇪🥨

One final 43 km spin before the big push to Copenhagen!

This ride is all about the ice breaker. Use these miles to meet the riders you’ll be chasing (and drafting) over the next few days. It’s also the perfect time for a final equipment test—better to catch a rattling bag or a gear tweak today than tomorrow morning!

📍 The Details

When: Friday, June 5th, 2026

Meetup: 3:30 PM

Roll-out: 3:30 PM Sharp ⏱️

Start Point: Standert Bicycles (Official Race Start)

Distance: ~43 km (Social shake out)

Pace: 27–28 km/h

Finish: Back at Standert for the Rider Briefing & Pasta Party 🍝

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Groups: We will split into smaller groups on the road to keep things safe.

Navigation: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit. ⚠️

Kit: Bring a flat kit for punctures and your best post-taper vibes.

The Pasta Party 🍝
We’ll finish up back at the shop for the official briefing and a pasta feed to fuel the journey ahead.

Sign Up:
If you’re not officially on the roster for the race to Copenhagen yet, head to:

👉 www.nordicchase.com

See you at the shop! ✌️

rides.title: Berlin to Copenhagen - Road Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
The Nordic Chase is expanding!
We’re launching a brand-new race in 2026: Berlin → Copenhagen.

For this race we are partnering with Standert as host partner in Berlin.

The route takes riders through Germany and Denmark, passing historic towns, rolling farmland, dense forests, and scenic coastal roads — finishing in the Capital of Denmark.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

Registrations are open:
👉 www.nordicchase.com
(limited capacity at 100 riders)

Registration includes:
1. Rider briefing and Pasta Party @Standert Bicycles (store in Berlin)
2. Official Race Manual with the race details 
3. Race cap and other goodies
4. Live GPS tracking
5. Finisher Certificate
6. Post-ride ceremony with drinks in Copenhagen
7. Photos taken by our media team
8. Entry to WhatsApp group chat to connect other riders
9. Small bag transfer rom the start to the finish

Register on https://nordicchase.com/ber-cph-road

Questions, then email to info@nordicchase.com

Please note: The final route and exact start location in Berlin will be provided in the race manual. The current route is a draft and will be verified by the organizer. The manual will be emailed to all registered participants three weeks before the race.

rides.title: Women's Ice Cream Ride
rides.description:
Join us on June 6th for our next Social ride led by our team of Rapha Ride Leaders; Lola, Olivia, Signe & Nora. This time on a Saturday as we enjoy some ice cream at Ismageriet in Amager after the ride.

On this social ride, we will ride together over some social loops on Amager. This ride is designed to increase your confidence riding alongside each other following the guidance of our Rapha Ride Leaders. This ride will take place with an average speed of 24-26kmh.

Tips and tricks before joining:

Please ensure you have knowledge of the common hand and voice signals before joining. 

Please remember to bring inner tubes, CO2 cartridges, water and snacks for the ride. Please also download the route onto your computer in advance.

Flat pedals, TT bikes and mountain bikes are not permitted on this ride. 

Meet-up: 09:15 at the Rapha Copenhagen Clubhouse (Kristen Bernikows Gade 7)
Departure: 09:30
Pace: 24-26kmh

Pre-ride coffee will be served to all at the Rapha Clubhouse before the ride.

Please remember a form of payment if you would like to purchase some ice cream.

We look forward to riding with you! 

If you can no longer join this ride, we kindly ask you to leave the ride on Strava so we can open your spot up to the next rider.

rides.title: Copenhagen Cycling Club Road Saturday
rides.description:
Lørdag den 6. juni køres der en ny landevejsrute fra Copenhagen Cycling Club. 

Vi skal op nordpå mod Tikøb, hvor der køres lidt opvarmning undervejs. Når vi drejer vestover køres der på et udvalg af lækre landeveje inden vi gør stop i Vejby, hvor der kan hældes benzin på dunken. 

Tempoet vil variere efter om der køres intervaller eller transport, men forvent en hård dag til bentøjet. Husk masser af sukker i dunken, downloadet rute, og plugs, slange, Co2 og den slags. 

Vi mødes ved butikken kl. 09.15 til de morgenfriske! Afgang 9.30 :)
